scope: Desktop setup, separate from historical NVIDIA runtime incidents

incidents.error: Single-GPU FP16 Trainer reached pre-optimizer callback, which rejected non-finite LoRA gradients; no completed SFT checkpoint
incidents.resolution: Retain failed costs and stack. New explicit non-quantized BF16 family, supported by AMD RDNA4 precision documentation and local torch.cuda.is_bf16_supported(). No claim that FP16 failure proves a driver fault or model-quality issue.

incidents.error: Native access violation 0xC0000005 after Trainer automatically enabled DataParallel across RX 9070 XT and integrated GPU; no completed SFT checkpoint
incidents.resolution: First capability and A-val succeeded. Preserve failed run and stack. Set process-only HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 and require exactly one visible 9070 XT in a new family; not yet claiming a confirmed driver root cause.
HTTP/1.1 shallow main clone succeeded; no reset or deletion

incidents.error: gh release download unexpected EOF, incomplete files
incidents.resolution: Preserved incomplete attempts, resumed short byte ranges, all three assets and 48 checkpoint files verified

incidents.error: Large streaming wheel installation did not complete
incidents.resolution: Stopped only project uv process before installation completed; official wheel ranges downloaded separately. No GPU execution/root-cause claim.

incidents.error: uv large-wheel downloads repeatedly interrupted; stopped only verified project uv process after preserving logs and cache
incidents.resolution: Pinned offline resolution retained in logs/desktop-common-resolved-plan.log; all 52 exact PyPI wheels downloaded in short ranges, checked against publisher SHA256/size/ZIP CRC, and installed offline. Editable project and pip check completed; final lock and package inventory retained.

incidents.error: Download stream ended early with 64-MiB requests
incidents.resolution: Preserved model parts; resumed in 2-MiB requests; all 11 pinned files verified, including both weight shards against official LFS SHA256

incidents.error: CIM inaccessible and gh keyring reported invalid login within sandbox
incidents.resolution: System credential/read-only host context succeeded; no user re-login or token disclosure
